title: Recount Text
summary: Reading past experiences and historical records: orientation, chronological sequence of events, temporal connectors, identifying causal turning points, and personal reflections.

lessons.title: Recount Varieties: Personal, Historical, and Biographical

blocks.html:
Recount text menceritakan kembali peristiwa yang sudah terjadi secara berurutan, untuk memberi informasi atau menghibur. Bentuknya bisa catatan harian, laporan kegiatan, pengalaman magang, biografi singkat, atau laporan peristiwa sejarah.

BagianIsi
Orientationsiapa, kapan, di mana, dan apa yang terjadi
Eventsrangkaian peristiwa secara kronologis
Reorientationpenutup: kesan, pendapat, atau pelajaran penulis (opsional)

blocks.title: Ciri kebahasaan
blocks.html:
• Simple past tense: went, saw, helped, was.
  • Penanda waktu dan urutan: last Saturday, on the first day, then, after that, finally, by noon.
  • Kata kerja tindakan (action verbs) dan nama orang atau tempat yang spesifik.
  • Kata ganti orang pertama (I, we) untuk recount pribadi; orang ketiga untuk recount faktual.

blocks.title: Soal urutan peristiwa
blocks.question: What happened right after the students lined up in the field?
steps: Cari penanda waktu: At seven, all the students lined up ... and the ceremony began.

blocks.question: Which sentence is most likely the reorientation of a recount?

options.A: Last week, our class visited a tea factory in Puncak.
options.B: First, the guide showed us how the leaves were dried.
options.C: After lunch, we walked through the tea plantation.
options.D: It was a fun trip, and now I appreciate every cup of tea I drink.

blocks.explanation: Kalimat D berisi kesan dan pelajaran penulis. A adalah orientation; B dan C adalah events.

blocks.question: Which word best describes the writer during the problem with the rope?
steps: Petunjuk: I stayed in position, as our coach had taught us.
Kepala sekolah memuji tim karena tetap tenang.

blocks.question: Why did the writer most likely arrive at school at six o'clock?

options.B: The writer had to raise the flag.
options.C: The writer was nervous and wanted to be ready.
options.D: The coach asked everyone to come at six.

blocks.hint: Tidak dinyatakan langsung; lihat petunjuk perasaan.

lessons.title: Extracting Values, Lessons, and Re-orientation Sentiments

blocks.html:
Extracting Values, Lessons, and Re-orientation Sentiments: Analyzing personal growth, takeaways, and concluding judgements expressed by authors.

Latihan bertahap ini dirancang untuk mengasah keterampilan analitis dalam menyelesaikan model soal standar TKA berbasis penalaran mendalam.

blocks.title: Strategi mengerjakan
blocks.html:
• Lingkari setiap penanda waktu (on the second day, in the afternoon, after that) untuk membangun garis waktu.
  • Soal correct order sering memakai pengecoh berupa urutan yang terbalik satu langkah: periksa setiap tanda panah.
  • Pesan atau pelajaran biasanya ada di reorientation, kalimat terakhir.
  • Untuk soal karakter, cari tindakan tokoh, bukan hanya kata sifat yang disebut.
